title: Axiom Protocol Durable Domain Model (DDM) v1.0.0-ogham
description: YAML validation schema for DDM files.

domain.description: Defines the durable domain model, including type vocabulary, entities, behaviors, and services.
Groups all durable domain model declarations used as the canonical model for generated artifacts.

scalars.description: Lists primitive scalar value types available to the domain model.

expr.description: Lists generic expression forms available for declaring typed domain values.

operators.description: Lists named operations that can be used in rules, constraints, and behavior conditions.

primitives.description: Lists constrained domain primitive types derived from scalar or expression types.

entities.description: Lists domain entities, their properties, relationships, and invariants.

behaviors.description: Lists domain behaviors with their dependencies, inputs, outcomes, and contract conditions.

services.description: Lists service surfaces that expose capabilities supporting domain behaviors.

scalar.description: Defines a named scalar type and optional syntax or explanatory notes.

syntax.description: Describes the scalar's textual or parameterized syntax, when applicable.

remarks.description: Provides explanatory notes about the scalar.

expression.description: Defines a named expression form with syntax, type parameters, and usage notes.

syntax.description: Describes the expression's textual or generic syntax.

where.description: Defines type parameters and constraints used by the expression.

remarks.description: Provides explanatory notes about the expression.

operator.description: Defines an operator, including syntax, operands, return values, and notes.

syntax.description: Describes the operator's invocation or infix syntax.

where.description: Defines named operands and their expected types.

returns.description: Defines named values produced by the operator.

remarks.description: Provides explanatory notes about the operator.

primitive.description: Defines a constrained domain primitive based on another type.

base.description: Identifies the scalar or expression type the primitive is based on.

from.description: Defines constructor or source parameters for deriving the primitive.

constraints.description: Lists validation constraints that values of the primitive must satisfy.

members.description: Lists named values for finite primitive value sets such as enumerations.

remarks.description: Provides explanatory notes about the primitive.

entity.description: Defines a domain entity with properties, relationships, rules, and notes.

name.description: Names the entity in singular form.

plural.description: Names the entity collection or plural form.

properties.description: Lists the entity's fields and their requiredness.

rels.description: Lists relationships from this entity to other domain types.

rules.description: Lists invariants or business rules that apply to the entity.

remarks.description: Provides explanatory notes about the entity.

relation.description: Defines a named entity relationship with exactly one relationship kind.

ownsMany.description: Identifies a collection of child entities owned by this entity.

ownsOne.description: Identifies a single child entity owned by this entity.

hasMany.description: Identifies a collection of associated entities not owned by this entity.

hasOne.description: Identifies a single associated entity not owned by this entity.

belongsTo.description: Identifies the parent or owning entity this entity belongs to.

remarks.description: Provides explanatory notes about the relationship.

behavior.description: Defines a domain behavior as a contract with dependencies, inputs, outputs, conditions, and exceptions.

uses.description: Lists domain types or services used by the behavior.

context.description: Defines ambient context required by the behavior, or none when no context is needed.

inputs.description: Lists explicit inputs accepted by the behavior.

returns.description: Lists named values returned by the behavior.

preconditions.description: Lists conditions that must hold before the behavior is performed.

postconditions.description: Lists conditions that must hold after the behavior completes successfully.

exceptions.description: Lists named exceptional outcomes and the conditions that trigger them.

remarks.description: Provides explanatory notes about the behavior.

service.description: Defines a service boundary and the capabilities it provides.

capabilities.description: Lists capabilities exposed by the service.

remarks.description: Provides explanatory notes about the service.

capability.description: Defines a named service capability and the behaviors it supports.

supports.description: Lists behavior names supported by this capability.

inputs.description: Lists explicit inputs accepted by the capability.

returns.description: Lists named values returned by the capability.

remarks.description: Provides explanatory notes about the capability.

typeParameter.description: Defines a named type parameter and any contained allowable values.

type.description: Identifies the type constraint for the parameter.

contains.description: Lists allowable member values or subtypes for the parameter.

remarks.description: Provides explanatory notes about the type parameter.

property.description: Defines a named, typed property and whether it is required.

required.description: Indicates whether the property must be present.

remarks.description: Provides explanatory notes about the property.

nameTypePair.description: Defines a reusable named type reference with optional notes.

remarks.description: Provides explanatory notes about the named type reference.

nameValuePair.description: Defines a reusable named literal value with optional notes.

value.description: Provides the literal string, number, or boolean value.

remarks.description: Provides explanatory notes about the named value.

nameConditionPair.description: Defines a reusable named condition with optional notes.

remarks.description: Provides explanatory notes about the named condition.

identifier.description: Defines the identifier format used for names in the domain model.

typeRef.description: References a scalar, expression, primitive, entity, service, or other declared domain type.

nullableText.description: Defines optional explanatory text that may be omitted with null.
